description: This file contains utility functions for handling Feishu (Lark) conversation IDs, including parsing, building, and normalizing conversation and target IDs, as well as extracting parent candidates for model overrides.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Normalizes input by trimming whitespace and returning undefined if input is not a string.

methods.name: buildFeishuConversationId
methods.description: Constructs a Feishu conversation ID based on parameters such as chat ID, scope, sender ID, and topic ID.

methods.name: parseFeishuTargetId
methods.description: Parses a raw input to extract a normalized Feishu target ID, removing provider prefixes.

methods.name: parseFeishuDirectConversationId
methods.description: Parses a raw input to extract a direct Feishu conversation ID, focusing on user or open ID prefixes.

methods.name: parseFeishuConversationId
methods.description: Parses a conversation ID to extract chat ID, topic ID, sender ID, and scope, returning a structured object.

methods.name: buildFeishuModelOverrideParentCandidates
methods.description: Generates parent candidate IDs for model overrides based on a given parent conversation ID.
